The structure of composition Mg6Sb2 (reduced formula Mg3Sb) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both elements: each Mg center has 12 geometric neighbors (8 Mg, 4 Sb) across 4 unit-cell atoms, while each Sb center has 12 Mg neighbors across 2 atoms. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and corner/face-sharing between Mg- and Sb-centered polyhedra.
